frozen_evidence_boundary: no issues, discussions, PRs or bug history before Phase B/C freeze
raw_signal_observation: DeleteInboxIssueModal is integrated into the inbox issue header. Its title, success message, and surrounding component use i18n translation calls, but the destructive confirmation body is a hard-coded English string. The source itself carries a TODO stating that the confirmation message needs translation.
material_claim: The current integrated path has a local internationalization defect: non-English locale selection cannot translate the confirmation body because the rendered content is an English literal even though the product's localization mechanism is active around it.
neta_next_move: Move the confirmation sentence into the existing inbox_issue i18n namespace, preserve the interpolated project identifier and sequence number, and add a locale-switch regression test that deliberately fails while the English literal remains.
reversal_condition: If the inbox deletion modal is intentionally excluded from localization by explicit product policy, withdraw the build; otherwise the hard-coded literal remains a repository-local violation of the active i18n contract.
baseline_decision: BUILD: replace the hard-coded English confirmation body with a translation key because the component already uses the translation system for title and outcome messaging.

evidence: Post-freeze PR #9639 adds Dutch as a supported language and describes broad localization across action prompts and product workflows, independently supporting that destructive prompts are inside the localization contract.
Earlier localization PR #8638 describes internationalization support across forms, tooltips, notifications, and modals, supporting the broader product contract but not this exact inbox string.
No issue or merged PR found in this reveal directly names the exact hard-coded DeleteInboxIssueModal confirmation body at the pinned SHA.
adjudication.decision_delta: No material advantage over baseline: both correctly choose a narrow repository-owned localization fix. The case contributes HOLDOUT score only and does not teach Neta before the wave closes.
adjudication.lesson: An explicit local TODO plus an integrated i18n boundary can justify BUILD_READY without field evidence, but neighboring localization work should not be laundered into exact-mechanism confirmation.
